prompt:
Design a 5 V NE555 astable oscillator near 2 Hz. Use the standard astable connection: pins 2 and 6 share the timing node, pin 7 lies between charge and discharge resistors, and a timing capacitor returns from the timing node to ground. Add a red output LED with a series resistor on pin 3. Use references U1, R1 (charge resistor), R2 (discharge resistor), C1, R3 (LED resistor), D1, VIN, GND and OUT. U1 pins are numbered 1 through 8; pin 1=GND, 2=TRIG, 3=OUT, 4=RESET, 5=CTRL, 6=THRESH, 7=DISCH, 8=VCC. D1 pins are A/K; each resistor and capacitor has A/B; ports VIN, GND and OUT have pin 1. Return exact values and the complete graph. Return JSON only using the supplied response schema.
Response schema: {"topology":"string","components":[{"ref":"string","kind":"resistor|capacitor|led|timer555|port|ground","value":"string or null","pins":["string"]}],"nets":[{"name":"string","terminals":["REF.pin"]}]}
